d:
Erica Andrikian (previously named Erica Andreyko) is one of the first OCs created by Andava.

"Erica is Brianna's close friend. Very much a gossip girl. She is the sleuth of her group, always getting information from Ester and Na-Na Kim. She doesn't like Darcy very much, she thinks she is full of crap because of Darcy's articles in the school newspaper. She becomes obsessed with finding anything she can nail Darcy for.

Raised in a large family as the only daughter, Erica learned quickly that if she wanted to stand out, she'd need to be tough! Even so, under her cold glare is an appreciative and loyal friend

Birthday: September ‎9

Height: 5'5" "
